thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout for service 'text-gen' 2026-03-15T09:46Z failed health checks in us-west-2 canary group. failing pods: text-gen-canary-7f9bd. Auto-paused after 30% failure rate.
incident-bot: Paging Sara (oncall) and Michael T — severity:P2 — tagged "impact:partial". Runbook: /runbooks/deploy/canary-failures.md
Sara (oncall): On it. grabbing logs from the canary now. Can someone confirm if the image tag for this rollout is 2026.03.15-preview-rc?
Jamie (release): It should be 2026.03.15-preview-rc. CI reported green but I saw a weird artifact warning in the pipeline: "artifact: mismatch digest" for the image pushed to registry.gcr.io/redwood/text-gen:preview-rc
Michael T: I see the same in the artifact manifest. Pipeline log snippet: `step=push image=registry.gcr.io/redwood/text-gen:preview-rc digest=sha256:aaaa... expected=sha256:bbbb...`
Dani Ops: That smells like a concurrent pipeline re-tag race. Maybe cache-poisoning in the runner. We rolled a rebuild earlier today.
Lina (platform): Confirming: the OCI manifest for digest bbbb... is different between storage backends (gcs vs local cache). Upload step retried and overwrote pointer.
Sara (oncall): So the canary likely pulled a different image than the release manager expected. That explains runtime regression. Customer impact?
Customer Success: We've seen 12 customer error reports in the last 18 minutes complaining about garbled completions and 502s from text-gen endpoints in us-west-2. No major accounts yet but a handful of mid-market customers.
Jamie (release): We need an immediate kill-switch path. Can we flip feature-flag "text-gen-new-model" to off for all traffic while we investigate?
Dani Ops: I'm ready to toggle. Suggest we pause the rollout and do an emergency rollback to the previous stable tag (2026.03.10-stable).
Sara (oncall): Steps please — I'll coordinate with CS for customer comms and track the incident timeline.
Dani Ops: Commands:
```
# pause rollout
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.redwood.internal/flags/text-gen-new-model/set -d '{"enabled":false,"actors":"all"}'
# rollback deployment
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/text-gen text-gen=registry.gcr.io/redwood/text-gen:2026.03.10-stable
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/text-gen
```
Lina (platform): Also disable canary autoscaler for this deployment to avoid spin-ups: `kubectl patch hpa text-gen -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`
Michael T: I'm running `kubectl get pods -l app=text-gen -o wide` to identify which nodes ran the bad image and will cordon them if necessary.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag update initiated by Dani Ops. Target: all environments in us-west-2.
Sara (oncall): Dani, please confirm when the flag is fully propagated. Jamie, start a status note for customers: short, honest, rollback in progress, ETA ~15m.
Jamie (release): Drafting now. "We detected an unstable canary after a deployment; we've disabled the new-model feature flag and are rolling back to a known-good release. We expect restoration within 20 minutes. Will follow up with root cause." Sending to CS for review.
Customer Success: Affected customers notified with a brief note, asking them to DM for impact details.
Dani Ops: Flag propagation shows 100% in us-west-2. Rolling back now.
Michael T: Rollback initiated. `kubectl rollout status` shows new replicaset available 1/3 -> 3/3 for stable image.
Sara (oncall): Observability — watch latency and error rate graphs. ops-bot, can you post a 1-min snapshot?
ops-bot: Attached: error_rate: 12.4% -> after rollback 3.1% (5m window). latency_p95: 780ms -> 210ms.
Lina (platform): We're also invalidating local registry cache entries and restarting the registry service to prevent further digest mismatch. Command: `gcloud compute ssh registry-01 -- sudo systemctl restart registry`
Jamie (release): CS says errors from customers are dropping. Good. Any change needed to CI?
Dani Ops: We should disable the parallel tag rewrite in the pipeline and add a digest verification gate (reject if pushed digest != expected). Opening a PR to the pipeline: add step verify-image-digest.sh with retries.
Michael T: Also propose we add a canary to only use immutable digest references for at least 24h after a publish.
Sara (oncall): Noted. For incident record: severity P2, duration initial detection -> rollback complete = 34 minutes. Customer impact: partial; transient errors to ~14 customers; no SSO or billing impact.
Jamie (release): Thanks all. I'll create the incident ticket in Jira and attach this thread, timeline, and CS notes.
Sara (oncall): Handoff: Michael T will follow up for postmortem; Lina to lead registry cache changes; Dani to harden CI verification; Jamie to manage customer follow-ups. I'll close the incident once the postmortem is filed.
Michael T: I'll start collecting build logs and pipeline artifacts (timestamps, checksums) and save them to /incidents/1845009999/artifacts.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback completed. Service health back to green in us-west-2.
Sara (oncall): Thanks team. Quick retrospective item: add explicit runbook for "artifact digest mismatch / registry cache". I'll add it to runbooks and assign owners.
Lina (platform): One more: adding registry signed manifest verification for future pushes.
Jamie (release): Logged customer follow-up tasks and scheduled PM review.
Customer Success: Customers have been updated with a follow-up; inbox monitoring in place.
Sara (oncall): Closing thread after postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
